name: Realtime pipeline bulk ingestion fan-out latency and throughput

description: Baseline build failed because the local enterprise manifest overlay was absent or stale.

asi.hypothesis: Establish a fresh retained-branch baseline before changing code.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate build used a Cargo manifest without enterprise workspace dependencies, causing 451 unresolved o2_enterprise, o2_openfga, and o2_dex errors.
asi.next_action_hint: Repair the documented local enterprise Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock build overlays, then rerun the unchanged baseline.

description: Established a valid fresh baseline after restoring the temporary enterprise build overlay.

asi.hypothesis: Repairing only the temporary enterprise manifest overlay restores valid black-box measurement without changing production behavior.
asi.correctness: Benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: The retained candidate is 57.57% lower in median latency and 57.89% higher in throughput than the fresh behavioral baseline.

description: Tried allocation-free source-size byte counting; latency and candidate throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Count serialized source bytes without allocating one temporary String per record while preserving exact usage-report byte counts.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate client latency regressed from 35.606 ms to 37.570 ms, and candidate throughput fell from 40,366 to 35,204 records/s despite black-box correctness passing.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid source-size serialization micro-optimizations; profile or reduce the 12-way PipelineItem deep-clone and channel fan-out costs instead.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and all healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Shared immutable executable nodes across per-request pipeline tasks.

asi.hypothesis: Store immutable executable pipeline nodes behind Arc so each request clones 28 pointers instead of all node metadata, function parameters, remote settings, and child identifiers.
asi.ownership_reason: Executable nodes are immutable after pipeline construction and must be owned by independently spawned node tasks.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median candidate latency improved 6.58%, from 35.606 ms to 33.262 ms; throughput remained within 1% at 40,141 records/s.

description: Tried sharing compiled VRL resolvers; candidate latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Share compiled VRL result resolvers across spawned function-node tasks to avoid 14 resolver clones per request.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 34.241 ms, while candidate throughput also fell from 40,141 to 39,646 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: The resolver clone is likely already shallow or not material; target per-node task metadata allocations or request-local channel and map setup.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Shared task metadata strings, but the remote org conversion borrowed non-static data.

asi.hypothesis: Share four immutable task-label strings across 28 spawned nodes to remove about 108 allocations per request.
asi.rollback_reason: Compilation failed because converting `org_id.as_ref()` into the remote stream field selected a borrowed `'static` conversion.
asi.next_action_hint: Retain Arc sharing, but convert `org_id.to_string()` at the existing flush-only owned-field boundary.

description: Tried sharing node-task label strings; latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Share pipeline ID, organization ID, pipeline name, and invocation ID across 28 spawned tasks to remove repeated String allocations.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 36.177 ms; candidate throughput stayed effectively flat at 40,011 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Task-label allocation is not the limiting cost; optimize request-local graph setup or per-record execution rather than metadata.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried allocation-free request-local channel indexing; latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Borrow node identifiers for the sender map and keep receivers in execution order, removing 56 request-local String allocations and one HashMap.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 35.472 ms; the 1.56% throughput increase was insufficient to offset the primary regression.
asi.next_action_hint: Channel-map setup is not material enough; investigate per-record fan-out cloning, VRL runtime initialization, or source-size accounting.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried borrowed VRL context strings; latency and throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Pass borrowed organization and stream strings into VRL metadata and secrets conversion, avoiding temporary String clones per function and record.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 34.776 ms, and candidate throughput fell from 40,141 to 39,579 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: String conversion inside VRL context is not material; consider reusing complete metadata and secret templates per function task.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried synchronous source-channel injection; both latency and throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Use guaranteed-capacity `try_send` for the sole source producer, removing one async send per input record without changing bounded capacity.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 36.779 ms, and candidate throughput fell 10.83% to 35,792 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Synchronous source injection may reduce useful scheduling overlap; keep awaited sends and target work inside node execution.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried full-request RemoteStream preallocation; memory pressure regressed both primary metrics.

asi.hypothesis: Size each RemoteStream record accumulator from its channel capacity, avoiding growth from 50 to 100 or 1,600 slots.
asi.rollback_reason: Median client latency regressed 22.18% from 33.262 ms to 40.639 ms, and throughput fell 5.94% to 37,757 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Exact full-request preallocation increases concurrent memory pressure; keep the bounded 50-record initial capacity.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Bypassed empty RemoteStream buffers for batches that already meet the flush threshold.

asi.hypothesis: When an empty per-key buffer receives at least 50 records, write the existing request vector directly to WAL instead of serializing, appending, reallocating, and immediately taking it.
asi.correctness_reason: The fast path only fires when the buffer is empty and the record-count threshold already requires an immediate flush; it retains ordering, WAL acknowledgement, usage counts, retries, and restart recovery.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median candidate latency improved 14.10%, from 33.262 ms to 28.571 ms. Candidate throughput remained within 1% at 39,887 records/s and measured 97.99% above baseline.

description: Direct vacant-entry flushing exposed an unnecessarily borrowed shard lifetime.

asi.hypothesis: Keep no empty map entry after a direct threshold flush, avoiding persistent buffer allocation and key cloning on every large request.
asi.rollback_reason: Compilation failed because `batch_buffer_shard` used an elided return lifetime tied to the temporary buffer-key borrow, preventing the key from moving into `HashMap::entry`.
asi.next_action_hint: Declare the returned global shard mutex as `'static`, then rerun the same entry-based direct-flush experiment.

description: Avoided retaining empty RemoteStream buffer entries after direct threshold flushes.

asi.hypothesis: Do not insert or retain empty BatchBuffer entries when an incoming group already meets the direct flush threshold; move the key into one Entry lookup.
asi.correctness_reason: Removing an empty entry resets the next small batch timer exactly as a new buffer would; nonempty buffers still preserve accumulated records and ordering.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median latency improved 7.53%, from 28.571 ms to 26.420 ms, and candidate throughput improved 3.96%, from 39,887 to 41,467 records/s.

description: Tried a synchronous fast path for buffer-shard locks; latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Use Tokio mutex `try_lock` before awaiting because direct-flush shard critical sections are short and often uncontended.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 26.420 ms to 29.613 ms, and throughput fell from 41,467 to 40,967 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: The explicit fast-lock branch harms scheduling or code shape; retain normal async locking and optimize work before or after the buffer map.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Grouped RemoteStream batch keys during record collection.

asi.hypothesis: Classify and group RemoteStream batch keys while receiving records, eliminating the second full-record scan for uniform keys and avoiding duplicate scans for mixed keys.
asi.correctness_reason: Each record uses the same post-transformation batch_key and default fallback as before; uniform and grouped vectors preserve the same records and routing groups.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median latency improved 4.50%, from 26.420 ms to 25.231 ms. Throughput remained within 1% at 41,225 records/s, and remote delivery latency improved.

description: Sized RemoteStream request accumulators to a bounded 64 records.

asi.hypothesis: Use a bounded 64-record RemoteStream accumulator, matching the production average and avoiding both the 50-to-100 latency reallocation and 1,600-slot throughput over-allocation.
asi.correctness_reason: Capacity changes allocation only; record order, thresholds, routing, and WAL contents stay unchanged.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median client latency improved 2.26%, from 25.231 ms to 24.660 ms. Candidate throughput remained within 1% at 40,990 records/s.

description: Allocation-free group iteration needed an ownership-safe Option iterator.

asi.hypothesis: Chain an optional uniform group with optional HashMap groups, removing the one-element Vec allocation per RemoteStream request.
asi.rollback_reason: Compilation failed because Iterator::map uses FnMut and cannot move the captured records vector, even though Option yields at most one item.
asi.next_action_hint: Use `uniform_batch_key.zip(Some(records)).into_iter()` before chaining grouped records, which moves both values without a closure.

description: Iterated RemoteStream routing groups without an intermediate vector.

asi.hypothesis: Iterate one optional uniform group and optional grouped map directly, removing one heap-allocated Vec per RemoteStream node and request.
asi.correctness_reason: Option and HashMap iterators yield the same owned `(batch_key, records)` groups; the grouping count log remains unchanged.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median client latency improved 5.97%, from 24.660 ms to 23.189 ms. Candidate throughput improved 1.09% to 41,437 records/s.

description: Parallelized fan-out clones with shared JSON ownership; throughput improved, but latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Share JSON values only at multi-child fan-out, then deep-clone them concurrently in mutating child tasks instead of serially in the upstream task.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput improved 5.72% to 43,808 records/s, but primary median client latency regressed 5.98% from 23.189 ms to 24.576 ms.
asi.next_action_hint: The Arc fan-out is a throughput option but misses the dual-metric goal; seek clone reduction without atomic sharing or preserve one moved branch while parallelizing others.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.learned: The serial fan-out clone is a measurable throughput cost, but Arc allocation and reference counting increase latency.

description: Rechecked moving the final fan-out item after structural wins; latency still regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Move the final PipelineItem into its child channel instead of deep-cloning it, removing one JSON clone per multi-child fan-out.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed 24.97% from 23.189 ms to 28.979 ms, and throughput fell 1.61% to 40,771 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not revisit final-child move semantics; channel scheduling effects outweigh one removed clone in this topology.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.context: This reconfirmed the earlier discarded final-child move after the retained buffer and grouping improvements.

description: Gated disabled key-event timing work; throughput rose slightly, but latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Skip per-node labels and per-record Instant measurements when ZO_PRINT_KEY_EVENT is disabled, while retaining identical timing logs when enabled.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed 15.89% from 23.189 ms to 26.874 ms; throughput improved only 1.62% to 42,108 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Instrumentation calls may affect task pacing or the retained 23.189 ms run may be unusually strong; do not keep without a primary win.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.surprise: Removing unused timing work did not improve client latency, despite a clear CPU cost model.

description: Tried 64 buffer shards; latency regressed without a throughput gain.

asi.hypothesis: Increase bounded buffer-map shards from 16 to 64 to reduce cross-destination collisions for 10-12 branch pipelines.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 23.189 ms to 24.162 ms, while throughput stayed flat at 41,218 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Sixteen shards already isolate this workload adequately; avoid increasing static lock count.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried preallocating request-local channel maps; both metrics regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Preallocate both 28-entry request-local channel maps to avoid repeated HashMap growth.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed 17.87% from 23.189 ms to 27.334 ms, and throughput fell 2.18% to 40,536 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not preallocate channel maps; their default growth interacts better with concurrent task startup or allocator pressure.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Confirmed the retained branch at 24.001 ms and 41,581 records/s without code changes.

asi.hypothesis: Re-measure the unchanged retained branch to quantify noise after several counterintuitive micro-optimization results.
asi.rollback_reason: The unchanged confirmation median was 24.001 ms versus the retained best 23.189 ms, so it did not establish a new primary win.
asi.next_action_hint: Treat roughly 0.8 ms and 1,000 records/s as run-to-run movement; require structural gains above that range.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Retained candidate throughput was 41,581 records/s, 68.04% above this run's unusually strong baseline.

description: Reused VRL context templates; throughput improved modestly, but latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Build VRL metadata and secrets once per function task, then clone cheap value templates per record instead of allocating all context strings repeatedly.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from the 23.189 ms best and 24.001 ms confirmation to 26.172 ms; the 2.74% throughput gain to 42,721 records/s did not offset the primary regression.
asi.next_action_hint: VRL context templates improve throughput modestly but miss the dual-metric goal; avoid adding this abstraction without a latency win.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried cached default buffer keys; the marginal result did not beat the retained latency.

asi.hypothesis: Cache each RemoteStream node's default buffer key and borrow it for direct vacant flushes, avoiding one format and String allocation per branch and request.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency was 23.640 ms versus the 23.189 ms retained best, and throughput improved only 0.61% to 41,690 records/s; the added field and branching were not justified.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep direct key construction local; target WAL serialization or branch execution for a structural throughput gain.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

name: Realtime pipeline bulk ingestion throughput after latency target

description: Established the throughput-phase baseline after exceeding the latency target.

asi.hypothesis: Start a throughput-focused phase after the retained branch exceeded the twofold latency target.
asi.phase_baseline: The unchanged retained branch delivered 41,752 records/s and 26.556 ms median client latency.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.guardrail: Keep client latency well below half of branch-v0.40.0 while optimizing throughput.

description: Parallelized deep JSON clones across fan-out child tasks.

asi.hypothesis: Move unavoidable deep JSON fan-out clones into parallel child tasks by sharing only multi-child records with Arc; keep single-child paths owned.
asi.ownership_reason: Each mutating receiver calls Arc::unwrap_or_clone, so branches retain independent Values while forwarding nodes share immutable input.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput improved 5.29%, from 41,752 to 43,962 records/s. Median client latency also improved from 26.556 ms to 22.811 ms, the best observed value.

description: Reused immutable VRL context templates per function task.

asi.hypothesis: Combine parallel fan-out cloning with one reusable VRL metadata and secrets template per function task.
asi.correctness_reason: Each VRL call clones the complete initial context before execution, preserving per-record metadata and secret isolation, error labels, and fallback behavior.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput improved to 44,632 records/s, 6.90% above the throughput-phase baseline. Median latency also improved to 21.719 ms, 75.36% below baseline branch latency. Throughput measured 91.44% above branch-v0.40.0.

description: Gated VRL timers; the throughput result was noise and latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Skip per-record VRL Instant measurements when key-event timing logs are disabled.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput changed only 0.14%, from 44,632 to 44,696 records/s, within noise, while median client latency regressed 18.73% from 21.719 to 25.787 ms.
asi.next_action_hint: Retain unconditional VRL timing because this branch does not deliver a meaningful throughput gain and worsens latency pacing.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried synchronous local-result sends; throughput was noise and latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Use result-channel `try_send` with awaited fallback to remove ready-future overhead for local pipeline outputs while preserving backpressure.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput improved only 0.36%, from 44,632 to 44,794 records/s, within noise, while client latency regressed from 21.719 to 26.316 ms.
asi.next_action_hint: Awaited local-result sends provide beneficial task pacing; do not replace them for a marginal throughput result.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried reusable VRL scratch contexts; the gain was noise and latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Reuse a mutable VRL context scratch object with `clone_from` to retain map allocations between records.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput improved only 0.56%, from 44,632 to 44,884 records/s, within noise, while median latency regressed 12.84% to 24.508 ms.
asi.next_action_hint: The VRL Value and Secrets clone_from implementations do not reuse enough storage to justify mutable scratch state.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Avoided normal-path JSON clones before VRL on shared fan-out records.

asi.hypothesis: Apply VRL directly from shared fan-out records and clone the original serde JSON only on transform errors, eliminating normal-path branch deep clones.
asi.correctness_reason: Cow preserves owned-call behavior; borrowed calls retain the immutable Arc source, and error paths clone that exact original record before returning it.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput improved 6.25%, from 44,632 to 47,420 records/s. Median client latency remained 73.91% below branch-v0.40.0 at 23.041 ms.

description: Reused unchanged VRL context storage across function records.

asi.hypothesis: Keep one mutable VRL context scratch per function task and reset it only when a transform changed metadata or secrets.
asi.correctness_reason: Every record starts with the exact template; unchanged contexts require no reset, while changed contexts clone the template before the next record.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput improved 3.18%, from 47,420 to 48,928 records/s, and reached 95.62% above branch-v0.40.0. Client latency remained 72.34% lower than baseline.

description: Confirmed more than twofold throughput and fourfold latency speed against branch-v0.40.0.

asi.hypothesis: Confirm the retained throughput gains and the twofold baseline target with a fresh isolated run.
asi.rollback_reason: The unchanged confirmation throughput of 48,475 records/s was 0.93% below the retained 48,928 records/s best, so it did not establish a new candidate-throughput win.
asi.next_action_hint: The target is now demonstrated: throughput was 101.17% above branch-v0.40.0, and client latency was 76.02% lower.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried a 128-record accumulator; throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Increase the bounded RemoteStream accumulator from 64 to 128 records, removing one growth step for 1,000-record requests without full-request preallocation.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 1.41%, from 48,928 to 48,239 records/s; the smaller 64-record capacity remains better overall.
asi.next_action_hint: Retain 64 records as the allocation balance for mixed latency and throughput workloads.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Borrowed the default RemoteStream batch key through routing.

asi.hypothesis: Borrow the common `default` batch key through grouping and allocate only non-default keys, removing one small String allocation per RemoteStream branch and request.
asi.correctness_reason: Cow converts to owned only when mixed-key HashMap grouping requires ownership; routing comparisons and buffer keys remain byte-identical.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Candidate throughput reached 48,946 records/s and 100.54% above branch-v0.40.0. Median client latency improved to 20.728 ms, 74.70% below baseline.

description: Tried manual Arc fan-out construction; throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Construct shared child items directly and move the final Arc into the last child, removing one reference-count increment and enum clone per fan-out.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 0.77%, from 48,946 to 48,567 records/s; the longer manual fan-out loop did not improve the primary metric.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the concise derived-clone fan-out implementation; compiler optimization and scheduling outweigh one Arc operation.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.target_result: Despite the discard, this run remained 103.63% above branch-v0.40.0 throughput and 75.29% lower in latency.

description: Confirmed the retained twofold throughput improvement in a second fresh run.

asi.hypothesis: Confirm that the retained twofold throughput result persists across a second fresh isolated benchmark.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: The unchanged candidate delivered 49,045 records/s, 102.63% above branch-v0.40.0, with client latency 73.62% lower. This independently confirms both requested targets.
asi.confidence: Two consecutive retained-branch runs exceeded 100% throughput improvement, at 101.17% and 102.63%.

description: Preserved the baseline RemoteStream flush timer after direct batch writes.

asi.hypothesis: Restore the baseline empty-buffer timestamp after direct threshold flushes while retaining the zero-copy request-vector WAL path.
asi.correctness_reason: Keeping the empty BatchBuffer and resetting last_write preserves the baseline rule that a later small batch flushes immediately after five idle seconds.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: The correctness fix also improved throughput to 49,713 records/s, 104.61% above branch-v0.40.0. Client latency remained 72.65% lower.
asi.review_source: A required scout review identified the stale-timer semantic difference.

description: Measured retained throughput variance; this run landed below the twofold margin.

asi.hypothesis: Measure retained-branch variance after the timer-semantics correction and three above-target runs.
asi.rollback_reason: The unchanged candidate delivered 48,261 records/s, 2.92% below the retained best, and this run measured 96.62% above a stronger baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: The target margin remains close to host noise; seek another structural 3-5% throughput gain before finalizing.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.variance: Recent unchanged or semantically equivalent retained runs span roughly 48.3k to 49.7k candidate records/s.

description: Tried simpler buffer-key formatting; throughput did not improve.

asi.hypothesis: Use captured format fields and a literal `remote` suffix for buffer keys, reducing formatting arguments in the 12-way hot path.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 0.57%, from 49,713 to 49,428 records/s; the formatting change did not beat noise despite strong latency.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the established buffer-key formatting; formatting is not the remaining bottleneck.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Bounded per-request pipeline channels to 64 records; throughput reached 49,942 records/s, a marginal new best within noise.

asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Bound all per-request pipeline channels to 64 records to reduce allocation and cache pressure while preserving asynchronous backpressure.
asi.observed: Candidate throughput improved 0.46% over the retained best, from 49,713 to 49,942 records/s, while remaining 102.88% above branch-v0.40.0. The gain is within recent run variance.
asi.risk: The smaller channel capacity changes task pacing but not record ownership, ordering, routing, or delivery cardinality.

description: Tried full-batch collector channels while bounding node channels; throughput regressed materially.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Retain full-batch result and error collector channels while bounding only the 28 node channels, avoiding collector backpressure while preserving most allocation savings.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep all pipeline channels bounded at 64; the uniform bound provides better task pacing than full-batch collector channels.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 6.88%, from 49,942 to 46,506 records/s, despite latency remaining comparable.

description: Rechecked the 64-record channel bound; the marginal throughput gain did not reproduce.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Re-measure the unchanged 64-record channel bound to distinguish a real throughput gain from host variance.
asi.next_action_hint: The bounded-channel gain did not reproduce; compare directly against the pre-channel retained commit before carrying this tuning into the finalized branch.
asi.rollback_reason: The unchanged confirmation delivered 48,437 records/s, 3.01% below run #44 and 2.57% below the pre-channel best of 49,713 records/s.
asi.variance: The confirmation remains within the recent retained-tree range, so the 64-record channel change lacks isolated evidence.

description: The pre-channel comparison did not compile because the revert omitted two channel arguments.

asi.error: Compilation failed because the exact revert removed channel_capacity before restoring the two collector-channel arguments.
asi.hypothesis: Measure the pre-channel retained implementation directly by removing the 64-record channel bound.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore all three channel constructors to batch_size in one edit, then rerun the same pre-channel comparison.
asi.rollback_reason: The partial revert left result and error channel constructors referencing an undefined channel_capacity local.

description: Measured the pre-channel implementation; throughput matched the bounded confirmation and did not improve the best.

asi.comparison: The pre-channel tree delivered 48,406 records/s, effectively equal to the bounded-channel confirmation at 48,437 records/s.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Measure the pre-channel retained implementation directly to isolate the effect of the 64-record channel bound.
asi.next_action_hint: Channel capacity is within host variance; stop tuning it and target a different structural cost.
asi.rollback_reason: Removing the channel bound did not beat the retained best of 49,942 records/s and offered no isolated throughput improvement.

description: Parallelized exact source-size counting; Rayon contention regressed throughput and latency.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Parallelize exact source-size serialization across records to use idle cores before pipeline task startup without changing usage accounting.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep sequential source-size serialization; Rayon scheduling contends with the already parallel bulk and pipeline work.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 3.51%, from 49,942 to 48,188 records/s, and median client latency rose from 23.819 to 25.523 ms.

description: Tried a copy-on-write VRL target; correctness passed, but throughput did not beat the smaller scratch context.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed, including context-sensitive transformations in the existing scenarios.
asi.hypothesis: Use a copy-on-write VRL target so metadata and secrets clone only when a transform mutates them, eliminating every-record deep equality checks.
asi.next_action_hint: The lazy target adds virtual dispatch and branch overhead that offsets avoided context comparisons; retain the smaller scratch-and-reset implementation.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput reached 49,148 records/s but remained 1.59% below the retained best, so the additional target implementation is not justified.

description: Gated disabled node timers; reduced clock work again harmed concurrent fan-out throughput.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Skip per-record Instant clock reads when key-event timing is disabled while preserving identical timing logs when enabled.
asi.next_action_hint: Retain unconditional timing calls; they appear to provide beneficial task pacing in this highly concurrent fan-out workload.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell 4.07%, from 49,942 to 47,909 records/s, despite client latency remaining comparable.

description: Tried lazy fallback stream-name allocation; an anomalous run regressed throughput sharply.

asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.hypothesis: Avoid eagerly allocating the unused fallback stream name for function nodes with a real stream name.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not infer causality from this anomalous run; the one-line allocation change is too small to explain the 20% drop, but it does not justify another noisy benchmark iteration.
asi.rollback_reason: Candidate throughput fell to 40,086 records/s, 19.74% below the retained best; the run also showed abnormal Prometheus throughput latency, so the change cannot be retained.
asi.variance: The result is an outlier relative to recent 48-50k records/s runs and likely reflects host contention.

name: Realtime pipeline bulk ingestion throughput — continued

description: Benchmark timed out at 900s during candidate throughput trials.

asi.next_action_hint: Increase timeout to 1200s.

description: Established segment-2 baseline with estimate_json_bytes and lock-free flush_all_buffers; 50,809 records/s, 116.48% above branch-v0.40.0.

asi.hypothesis: Replace allocating record.to_string() with non-allocating estimate_json_bytes in process_batch and add_records; fix flush_all_buffers to release shard locks before async WAL writes.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput reached 50,809 records/s, 116.48% above branch-v0.40.0, a new session best. Client latency was 22.897 ms, 73.07% below baseline.

description: Avoided cloning ExecutablePipeline in bulk.rs pipeline check; throughput did not improve.

asi.hypothesis: Add has_executable_pipeline to avoid a full ExecutablePipeline clone in bulk.rs just for an existence check.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput fell 1.80% from 50,809 to 49,896 records/s; the pipeline check clone is not a measurable bottleneck because it happens once per stream per request.
asi.next_action_hint: The single-per-stream pipeline lookup is not hot enough. Focus on per-record or per-node work inside process_batch.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Benchmark timed out at 1200s; increase to 1500s.

asi.hypothesis: Bypass source node task by sending directly to its children.
asi.rollback_reason: Timeout, not a code issue.
asi.next_action_hint: Increase timeout to 1500s.

description: Bypassed source node task; throughput fell 2.6%, likely due to changed task scheduling.

asi.hypothesis: Skip the source node task and send records directly to its children, eliminating 1 task + 2000 channel ops per 1000-record request.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput fell 2.6% from 50,809 to 49,482 records/s. The source node task likely provides beneficial scheduling overlap with the Tokio runtime.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the source node task; it provides useful pacing. Focus on reducing per-record work inside function/RemoteStream nodes.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Wrapped VRL resolvers in Arc to avoid cloning compiled programs per-request; throughput within noise.

asi.hypothesis: Store VRL resolvers as Arc<(VRLResultResolver, bool)> so per-request task spawns clone only the Arc, not the compiled VRL program.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput was 50,091 records/s, 1.4% below the baseline of 50,809; within noise and not an improvement.
asi.next_action_hint: The VRL resolver clone is not a measurable bottleneck because the ExecutablePipeline cache clone already uses Arc for nodes. Focus on per-record work, not per-request overhead.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Replaced HashMap node lookups with precomputed indexed arrays; throughput effectively flat.

asi.hypothesis: Precompute indexed node arrays (sorted_exec_nodes, sorted_vrl, child_indices) during construction and use Vec indexing in process_batch instead of HashMap lookups.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput was 50,696 records/s, 0.22% below the baseline. The HashMap operations are not a measurable bottleneck with only 28 nodes per request.
asi.next_action_hint: The per-request node setup overhead is negligible. Focus on improving the actual record processing: WAL write path, VRL conversion, or reducing channel contention.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: First-record size sampling caused catastrophic throughput regression; something downstream depends on accurate source_size.

asi.hypothesis: Estimate source_size from first record × count instead of traversing all records.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput collapsed to 17,533 records/s, 65.5% below baseline. The first-record estimate likely inflated source_size, which affected usage reporting thresholds or other downstream behavior.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the full estimate_json_bytes traversal. Do NOT sample source_size — the value must be accurate. Investigate whether usage reporting or another consumer has a threshold-sensitive path.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle passed but throughput regressed catastrophically.

description: Confirmed retained baseline at 50,329 records/s; host is stable.

asi.hypothesis: Confirm the unchanged retained tree is stable after the anomalous run #65.
asi.rollback_reason: The unchanged code does not beat its own recorded best.
asi.next_action_hint: The reproducible cluster is 50.0-50.8k records/s. Target a structural throughput gain above 52k.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.variance: Retained code reproduced at 50,329 records/s, confirming the 50k cluster.

description: Merged source_size estimation into record feeding loop; throughput within noise.

asi.hypothesis: Merge the source_size estimation pass with the record feeding loop to avoid two sequential passes over all records.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput was 50,506 records/s, 0.6% below the baseline. The two-pass overhead is negligible because the estimate_json_bytes call is non-allocating and cache-friendly.
asi.next_action_hint: The record iteration overhead is not a bottleneck. Try reducing actual per-record processing cost: VRL conversion path or RemoteStream record handling.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Try_send for source feed improved latency 17% but throughput stayed within noise.

asi.hypothesis: Use try_send with await fallback in the source feed loop to avoid unnecessary task yields when the channel has capacity.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput was 50,535 records/s, 0.5% below the baseline of 50,809. Client latency improved significantly (18.93 ms vs 22.90 ms baseline), but throughput is the primary metric and did not improve.
asi.next_action_hint: The latency win suggests try_send helps pipelining, but it doesn't translate to throughput because the throughput bottleneck is downstream. Consider combining try_send with other downstream optimizations.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.latency_note: The baseline ran with unusually high latency (133.757 ms), inflating the latency_vs_baseline_percent. The candidate latency of 18.93 ms is genuinely better than recent 22-23 ms results.

description: Fixed pipeline_inputs capacity from destination count to actual record count; throughput matched best at 50,896 records/s.

asi.hypothesis: Pre-allocate pipeline_inputs and original_options vectors with the actual input record count instead of destination count (fixing a capacity bug that caused ~10 reallocations for 1000-record requests).
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Throughput reached 50,896 records/s, matching the previous best. Client latency was 20.86 ms, 76.60% below baseline. The throughput improvement is within noise, but the capacity fix prevents reallocations.
asi.variance: The result is within the 50.0-50.9k reproducible cluster.

description: Fused linear function chains (common-01 → common-02); throughput within noise, remote delivery latency improved 19%.

asi.hypothesis: Fuse sequential function → function chains into one task, eliminating 1 channel and 1 task per chain. For the benchmark, common-01 and common-02 are fused into a single task.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput was 50,332 records/s, 1.1% below the baseline of 50,896. The channel and task overhead saved is apparently recouped by Tokio scheduler pipelining.
asi.next_action_hint: The pipelining of common-01 → common-02 through a channel provides beneficial scheduling overlap. Fusing them serializes the two VRL transforms on one task, reducing parallelism. Keep separate tasks.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.remote_delivery: Remote delivery latency improved 19% (1292 ms vs 1595 ms), suggesting better scheduling for downstream WAL writes.

description: Skipped estimate_json_bytes for same-stream pipeline results; throughput fell 3%.

asi.hypothesis: Skip per-record estimate_json_bytes in pipeline result handling when destination stream matches source stream.
asi.rollback_reason: Throughput fell 3% from 50,896 to 49,363 records/s. The result handling path is not the throughput bottleneck; it runs after pipeline execution completes.
asi.next_action_hint: The pipeline execution path (VRL + channel scheduling) is the remaining bottleneck. The result handling overhead is negligible compared to the pipeline work.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
